lookups.why: Find callers of `shorten` to determine whether any pass a hard length ceiling (e.g. a GitHub check-run title cap) and rely on the output being within `limit` characters rather than `limit + 1`.
Find callers of `first_sentence` to confirm the ". "-only heuristic does not regress any existing behaviour they depend on.

value.summary: The new `summarise.rs` implements `shorten` and `first_sentence` with character-aware slicing and includes tests for multibyte safety. The logic looks correct on its own, but the `shorten` doc claims the output is "at most `limit` characters" while the implementation can return up to `limit + 1` (truncated text plus the ellipsis); I want to check the callers to see whether any of them pass a hard ceiling that this overflow would breach.
